title: CrewAI CLI Commands
summary: This module provides a comprehensive set of command-line interface (CLI) commands for managing CrewAI projects, including crew execution, deployment, tool management, configuration, and tracing.

nodes.label: crewai
nodes.title: Main CLI Entry Point
nodes.description: The main command-line interface entry point for all CrewAI operations.

nodes.label: UV Package Manager
nodes.title: UV Package Manager Wrapper
nodes.description: Wraps `uv` commands, injecting custom tool authentication credentials for package management.

nodes.label: Log Task Outputs
nodes.title: Log Task Outputs
nodes.description: Retrieves and displays the outputs from the latest `crew.kickoff()` tasks for review.

nodes.label: Start Interactive Chat
nodes.title: Start Interactive Chat
nodes.description: Starts an interactive conversation with the Crew, enabling dynamic input and LLM-generated responses.

nodes.label: Run Crew
nodes.title: Run Crew
nodes.description: Executes the defined Crew, orchestrating agents and tasks to achieve a specified goal.

nodes.label: Train Crew
nodes.title: Train Crew
nodes.description: Trains the Crew for a given number of iterations, potentially enhancing its performance and capabilities.

nodes.label: Test Crew
nodes.title: Test Crew
nodes.description: Tests the Crew's functionality and evaluates its results over multiple iterations against defined criteria.

nodes.label: Create Tool
nodes.title: Create Tool
nodes.description: Generates a new tool project structure, facilitating the development of custom tools for CrewAI.

nodes.label: Install Tool
nodes.title: Install Tool
nodes.description: Installs a specified tool, making it available for immediate use within CrewAI projects.

nodes.label: Publish Tool
nodes.title: Publish Tool
nodes.description: Publishes a developed tool to the CrewAI platform, with an option to make it publicly accessible.

nodes.label: Create Deployment
nodes.title: Create Deployment
nodes.description: Initializes a new deployment for a CrewAI project on the platform, setting up its infrastructure.

nodes.label: Push Deployment
nodes.title: Push Deployment
nodes.description: Deploys the current CrewAI project to the platform or updates an existing deployment with new changes.

nodes.label: List Deployments
nodes.title: List Deployments
nodes.description: Retrieves and displays a comprehensive list of all active CrewAI project deployments.

nodes.label: Get Deployment Status
nodes.title: Get Deployment Status
nodes.description: Fetches and presents the current operational status of a specific CrewAI deployment.

nodes.label: Get Deployment Logs
nodes.title: Get Deployment Logs
nodes.description: Retrieves and displays the execution logs for a specified CrewAI deployment for debugging and monitoring.

nodes.label: Remove Deployment
nodes.title: Remove Deployment
nodes.description: Deletes a specified CrewAI project deployment from the platform, cleaning up resources.

nodes.label: Validate Deployment
nodes.title: Validate Deployment
nodes.description: Performs pre-deployment checks on the current project to identify potential issues before actual deployment.

nodes.label: Configure Enterprise
nodes.title: Configure Enterprise
nodes.description: Configures CrewAI AMP OAuth2 settings using a provided Enterprise URL for secure access.

nodes.label: List CLI Config
nodes.title: List CLI Config
nodes.description: Displays all current CLI configuration parameters, providing an overview of settings.

nodes.label: Set CLI Config
nodes.title: Set CLI Config
nodes.description: Sets a specific CLI configuration parameter to a new value, allowing customization.

nodes.label: Reset CLI Config
nodes.title: Reset CLI Config
nodes.description: Resets all CLI configuration parameters to their default values, restoring initial settings.

nodes.label: List Organizations
nodes.title: List Organizations
nodes.description: Lists all organizations the authenticated user has access to within the CrewAI platform.

nodes.label: Logout
nodes.title: Logout
nodes.description: Logs out the user from CrewAI AMP, clearing authentication tokens and optionally resetting CLI configuration.

nodes.label: Enable Tracing
nodes.title: Enable Tracing
nodes.description: Activates the collection of execution traces for CrewAI projects, sending them to CrewAI+ for analysis.

nodes.label: Disable Tracing
nodes.title: Disable Tracing
nodes.description: Deactivates the collection of execution traces for CrewAI projects, stopping data transmission.

nodes.label: Tracing Status
nodes.title: Tracing Status
nodes.description: Displays the current status of trace collection, including environment variable overrides and user consent.

nodes.label: Run Flow
nodes.title: Run Flow
nodes.description: Initiates the execution of a defined CrewAI Flow, guiding agents through a sequence of tasks.

nodes.label: Plot Flow
nodes.title: Plot Flow
nodes.description: Generates a visual representation or diagram of the CrewAI Flow structure for better understanding.

nodes.label: Add Crew to Flow
nodes.title: Add Crew to Flow
nodes.description: Integrates an existing crew into a specified flow, expanding its capabilities and task handling.

nodes.label: List Triggers
nodes.title: List Triggers
nodes.description: Lists all available triggers from integrated platforms that can initiate CrewAI workflows.

nodes.label: Run with Trigger
nodes.title: Run with Trigger
nodes.description: Executes a crew using a specified trigger payload, simulating an external event.

nodes.label: Reset Memories
nodes.title: Reset Memories
nodes.description: Deletes various types of stored crew memories, including long-term, short-term, entities, knowledge, and kickoff outputs.

nodes.label: List Templates
nodes.title: List Templates
nodes.description: Displays a list of available project templates, aiding in the quick setup of new CrewAI projects.

nodes.label: Add Template
nodes.title: Add Template
nodes.description: Adds a selected project template to the current directory, providing a starting point for development.

nodes.label: Resume Checkpoint
nodes.title: Resume Checkpoint
nodes.description: Resumes a CrewAI execution from a specified checkpoint, or the most recent one, to continue work.

nodes.label: Diff Checkpoints
nodes.title: Diff Checkpoints
nodes.description: Compares the state and content of two different CrewAI checkpoints, highlighting changes.

nodes.label: Checkpoint Info
nodes.title: Checkpoint Info
nodes.description: Displays detailed information about a specific CrewAI checkpoint, including its metadata.

nodes.label: List Checkpoints
nodes.title: List Checkpoints
nodes.description: Lists all available checkpoints within a specified directory, showing their IDs and creation times.

nodes.label: Prune Checkpoints
nodes.title: Prune Checkpoints
nodes.description: Removes old or unwanted checkpoints based on criteria like age or quantity, managing storage.

nodes.label: CLI Core Authentication
nodes.title: CLI Core Authentication
nodes.description: Handles user authentication, token management, and provides base command functionalities for the CLI.

nodes.label: Checkpoint CLI Logic
nodes.title: Checkpoint CLI Logic
nodes.description: Provides core logic for managing CrewAI checkpoints, including listing, diffing, and pruning.

nodes.label: Deployment Validation
nodes.title: Deployment Validation
nodes.description: Contains logic for validating CrewAI project configurations against deployment requirements.

nodes.label: Tasks and Flow Core
nodes.title: Tasks and Flow Core
nodes.description: Manages the execution, plotting, and modification of CrewAI Flows.

nodes.label: Events and State Core
nodes.title: Events and State Core
nodes.description: Manages event handling, state, and memory persistence for CrewAI operations.

nodes.label: Utilities and Config Core
nodes.title: Utilities and Config Core
nodes.description: Provides various utility functions and configuration management for the CrewAI framework.

groups.label: CLI Core & Utilities
groups.title: Core CLI Functionality
groups.description: Commands for the main CLI entry point and utility functions like package management.

groups.label: Crew Execution & Evaluation
groups.title: Manage Crew Runs
groups.description: Commands for running, training, testing, and interacting with CrewAI agents and their outputs.

groups.label: Flow Management
groups.title: Manage CrewAI Flows
groups.description: Commands for executing, visualizing, and modifying CrewAI Flows.

groups.label: Deployment Lifecycle
groups.title: Manage Deployments
groups.description: Commands for creating, pushing, listing, monitoring, and removing CrewAI project deployments.

groups.label: Checkpoint Management
groups.title: Manage Checkpoints
groups.description: Commands for resuming, comparing, inspecting, listing, and pruning CrewAI execution checkpoints.

groups.label: Tool & Template Management
groups.title: Manage Tools and Templates
groups.description: Commands for creating, installing, publishing tools, and managing project templates.

groups.label: Configuration & Authentication
groups.title: Manage CLI Settings and Auth
groups.description: Commands for configuring enterprise settings, managing CLI parameters, and user authentication.

groups.label: Tracing & Monitoring
groups.title: Control Trace Collection
groups.description: Commands for enabling, disabling, and checking the status of trace collection for CrewAI executions.

groups.label: Trigger & Memory Management
groups.title: Manage Triggers and Memories
groups.description: Commands for listing and running triggers, and resetting various types of crew memories.
